description: Figure 7 is a line plot comparing the MRR@10 performance of different query selection strategies for training DPR, evaluated on the MS-Marco dev set. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” ranges from 1 to 10 with integer tick marks. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” ranges from 33.0 to 36.5 with major tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Six distinct strategies are plotted, each represented by a solid line (corresponding to corpus expansion during inference) and a matching dotted line (corresponding to typical representation during inference). The “DPR w/o query” strategy (black solid line) remains flat at approximately 34.26 across all S values. The “DPR w/ gold” strategy (yellow solid line) starts at ~33.0 when S=1, rises steadily to ~35.0 at S=10, while its dotted counterpart (yellow dotted line) stays near 34.5. The “DPR w/ top-1” strategy (green solid line) begins at ~33.0, increases sharply to ~35.0 at S=3, and continues rising to ~36.4 at S=10; its dotted line (green dotted) starts at ~34.5 and remains nearly flat. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” strategy (purple solid line) starts at ~34.8, dips slightly, then rises to ~35.0 at S=10; its dotted line (purple dotted) stays near 34.7. The “DPR w/ random” strategy (blue solid line) starts at ~34.8, rises slightly to ~35.2 at S=10; its dotted line (blue dotted) remains near 35.1. The “DPR w/ curriculum” strategy (red solid line) starts at ~35.1, rises to ~35.7 at S=3, then plateaus near 35.8; its dotted line (red dotted) remains flat at ~35.6. The legend identifies each strategy by color and marker shape, and the caption clarifies that solid and dotted lines of the same color correspond to the same DPR model evaluated under different inference methods.
